# External documentation (client administrators)

Lightly-guided, **manual-operations-only** bundle for **client Salesforce administrators**. No code, no
command line, no package to install — everything is done in the Salesforce UI. Advisory tone,
client-neutral, no internal SE detail.

It presents **two options** for gaining visibility into Agentforce / GenAI usage, and makes clear that
**the Digital Wallet remains the billing source of truth**.

## Bundle contents

Available in **French** (`fr/`) and **English** (`en/`). Start with the Guide.
